crossRefs.note: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

translations.web: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
translations.bsb: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the Gershonite clans.
